notes: The kept set covers PCAWG pan-cancer work (signatures, timing, SVs, non-coding drivers, intratumour heterogeneity), tumour-type and clinical-scale landscapes (breast, liver, GI, cholangiocarcinoma, DLBCL, prostate, paediatric, MSK-IMPACT, TMB, MSI, hypermutation), mutational-signature aetiology (tobacco, pks+ E. coli, DNA-repair knockouts, ERCC2, HRD, CNA signatures), clonal and tumour evolution (neutral evolution, glioblastoma, chromosomal instability, single-cell myeloid, pre-AML) and somatic mutation in normal tissues. The set leans towards breast cancer. Several landmarks are absent because they were not on the shortlist: TRACERx lung evolution, chromothripsis and ecDNA, the Martincorena normal skin and oesophagus papers, and the TCGA PanCancer Atlas.
